_comment: The kitchen's complete voice-over script. This file is BOTH the durable production record (CONCEPT.md §7.3: 'a plain-text script file of every line') AND the runtime manifest — it is bundled into the app and read by VoiceBank.swift, which maps line id -> variant files. Adding a line means adding it here and generating its mp3; no Swift change is needed. Regenerate any line with the character's voice_id below and the mp3 filename recorded on the variant.
_generated: 2026-08-15 — kitchen, then five sources and the plank step

_line_ids._comment: What the game calls, and when. Every id here is referenced from Swift; every id in Swift exists here.
_line_ids.nina.keuken.doeInKom: Nudge: something from the basket belongs in the bowl.
_line_ids.nina.ingredient.*: One reaction per ingredient, as it lands in the bowl. Names the colour it will give.
_line_ids.nina.keuken.roerenGoedZo: Halfway through stirring. Encouragement, never correction.
_line_ids.nina.keuken.gieten: Nudge: pour the bowl into the tin.
_line_ids.nina.keuken.naarOtto: Nudge: carry the tin to Otto.
_line_ids.nina.keuken.klopOpOtto: Nudge: tap Otto to start baking.
_line_ids.nina.taart.*: Reaction to the cake that came out, chosen by GAMEPLAY.md §5's colour rule.
_line_ids.nina.effect.*: Follows the colour line when the cake sparkles, glows or is tall.
_line_ids.nina.oeps: A drag that landed nowhere. Never negative — GAMEPLAY.md §7.
_line_ids.nina.speel.bloem: Occasionally, when the flour sack is thumped.
_line_ids.nina.stil: The 45-second idle line. Never twice in a row.
_line_ids.nina.klaar: The cake is on the plank and the round is over.
_line_ids.nina.plank.gezet: Second line of the finishing celebration: it is up there with the others. Three variants, one of which is simply being proud of her — the round ends on a person rather than on a fact.
_line_ids.nina.plank.nogeen: Third and last: what happens next. Added 2026-08-16 because the round used to reset three quarters of a second after the cake landed, which read as the game throwing her work away rather than putting it up. The rebuild now waits for this line to finish.
_line_ids.nina.kamer.klaar: The third cake landed and the kitchen is finished. Replaces nina.plank.nogeen in the closing chain from that cake on, and is also how a finished kitchen greets her when she comes back to it. Points at the door.
_line_ids.nina.kamer.deur: Tapping the open door once the kitchen is finished — the room's ending. Promises the next room *soon* rather than *now*, because it does not exist yet and a 4-year-old told she is going somewhere has to be taken there.
_line_ids.nina.keuken.opDePlank: The round's last step: carry the finished cake up onto the taartenplank. Replaced tapping the doorway.
_line_ids.nina.bron.plankHoog: Source 0, the upper wall shelf — the highest reach in the room.
_line_ids.nina.bron.krat: Source 4, the crate on the floor — the lowest reach. Replaced nina.bron.plank, which could not say which of two shelves it meant.
_line_ids.otto.tik: Otto is tapped. Five variants because she will tap him constantly.
_line_ids.otto.wacht: Otto is open and waiting for the tin.
